g.text: Terms: AI = artificial intelligence (here, an AI assistant drafting at independence level I0) · ARP4754B = SAE guidelines for development of civil aircraft and systems · ARP4761A = SAE guidelines for the safety assessment process on

civil aircraft · CONOPS = concept of operations · DoD = US Department of Defense · F-nnn = system function in the item definition · FHA = functional hazard analysis (MIL-STD-882E Task 208; also ARP4761A aircraft FHA) · GNSS = global

navigation satellite system (GPS and similar) · GPS = Global Positioning System · HAZ-nnn = hazard record (safety/hazards/HAZ-xxx-nnn.yaml) · I0–I3 = review independence level (I0 none, e.g. the author or an AI, to I3 independent

organisation) · MIL-STD-882E = US DoD Standard Practice for System Safety (11 May 2012, base edition) · SAE = SAE International, publisher of ARP4754B and ARP4761A · SCN-nnn = CONOPS scenario (SCN-0nn nominal, SCN-1nn off-nominal) ·
UAV = uncrewed aerial vehicle (drone) · US = United States
